name: cx-timeline
description: CX Timeline — hosted interactive timeline & commissioning planner

scripts.test: node tools/test_dist.js && node tools/test_lookahead.js && node tools/smoke.js && node tools/smoke_folder.js && node tools/smoke_desktop.js && node tools/smoke_hosted.js && node tools/smoke_calendar.js && node tools/test_sql.js
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri dev
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run build:desktop && cd src-tauri && cargo tauri build

cxTimeline._comment: deployment: 'hosted' saves the plan to Supabase and requires a backend at build time; 'folder' publishes with no backend at all and keeps the plan in a folder the user picks; 'calendar' is 'folder' plus the resource calendar — the plan still has no backend and still lives in a folder, while the calendar has its own separate Supabase project so the team can read it in a browser. tools/dist.js reads this, so the shape of a deployment is decided here, in the repository, rather than in a CI setting nobody can see. The calendar shape needs RC_SUPABASE_URL and RC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY as build variables and refuses to publish without them. updateChannel: the deployment an installed desktop copy follows for updates — blank means an installed copy never updates itself.
